rv.t: I have dedicated almost 8 months to beating this game. during that time, I lost my wife, my kids, and the 2018 Toyota Camry LE. I expect compensation. 10/10!
I absolutely love this game and wouldn't dare to play anything else ever again. Two years ago I ran over a family of 3 in a hummer and never told anyone. Play this game!
They now use Ai for ads, came across it on TIKTOK, I will no longer be supporting this game.
